behavioral_notes.observation: ~30 country-specific validators (check_vat_al/ch/mx/no/pe/ru/ve/in/br/sa/tw/uy/id/cr/vn/gr/hu/ro/...) implement local checksum + regex rules (e.g. Swiss MOD11, Norway weighted check digit, Mexican RFC date check, Venezuelan kind+checksum, Indian GSTIN regex). _check_vat_number dispatches via getattr(self,'check_vat_'+cc) and falls back to stdnum's is_valid when no override exists; _format_vat_number does the same for format_vat_<cc>. The validation logic lives entirely in Python, invisible to metadata.

Default validation/formatting engine is the external python-stdnum library: stdnum.util.get_cc_module(country_code,'vat').is_valid / .compact, plus stdnum.luhn. The module's own check_vat_* methods exist mainly to patch cases where stdnum lags (TW Feb-2025 div-by-5, VN CCCD 12-digit from 2025, UY RUT starting 22, ID 2024 16-digit format). External dependency not declared in __manifest__ external_dependencies.

When a company enables vat_check_vies, editing a partner VAT triggers _compute_vies_valid -> _check_vies_iap, which POSTs to Odoo IAP (https://vies.api.odoo.com, or vies.test.odoo.com in demo) /api/vies/1/check_validity to query the EU VIES registry and set vies_valid. A 'pending' result is resolved asynchronously either by cron base_vat.vies_iap_check_update (_cron_check_vies_iap polling /api/vies/1/check_update) or by IAP calling back the inbound webhook. db_uuid + per-db IAP client_identifier/token identify the database. Live network side-effect, not in metadata.

Public HTTP route (auth=public, csrf=False) that IAP calls to push a resolved VIES status for a previously pending VAT. Trust is enforced by verify_hash_signed over a server-signed 'vies_check' token (hash_sign, 7-day expiry) generated in _check_vies_iap; on match it searches res.partner by vat and calls _update_vies_status, logging a chatter message. Demonstrates an inbound integration callback metadata only shows as one bare route.

The VAT constraint itself is defined in the account dependency (_check_vat iterates partners and validates commercial_partner_id.country_id + vat). base_vat wires it to actually run by overriding _run_vat_checks (the real validation/format/EU-prefix + VIES-required logic) and binding the constraint through inverse _inverse_vat on the vat and country_id fields (plus _onchange_vat for live UI feedback with validation=False). Context key 'no_vat_validation' / single '/' bypasses validation for API pushes.

No frontend assets: present=false, 0 JS files, 0 XML templates, 0 OWL components, 0 registry registrations, 0 patches, no asset bundles. All behaviour is server-side (ORM compute/constraint/cron + one HTTP webhook controller); UI surfaces are the inherited res.partner/res.company/res.config.settings forms owned by base/account.

2 outbound HTTP call sites in models/res_partner.py; SDK ['requests']; uses_api_keys=False (IAP auth is db_uuid + per-db client token, not a user API key); endpoints ['https://vies.api.odoo.com', 'https://vies.test.odoo.com'] (Odoo IAP VIES proxy).

it_architecture.application: base_vat (VAT Number Validation extension component; owns no model, extends res.partner/res.company/res.country/res.config.settings)
information_flows: side-effect: write res.partner.vat/country_id -> _inverse_vat -> _check_vat -> _run_vat_checks (validate/format) -> ValidationError if invalid
outbound: _check_vies_iap POST https://vies.api.odoo.com/api/vies/1/check_validity (EU VIES via Odoo IAP)
uses python-stdnum (get_cc_module(cc,'vat').is_valid/.compact, luhn) as default validator/formatter

capabilities: Validate Tax/VAT Identification Numbers (per-country format & checksum)
value_streams: Master-data quality: enter partner VAT -> validate format/checksum -> (EU) VIES check -> mark vies_valid / block invalid -> trusted Tax ID for downstream invoicing & tax determination
information_concepts: res.partner (vat, vies_valid; owns no new entity — extends the partner/company)
policies: Constraint _check_vat on commercial_partner_id rejects malformed VAT (ValidationError) on write of vat/country_id
VIES validity can be required for fiscal-position selection (_get_vat_required_valid) when company is in EU or partner country has a foreign fiscal position
Bypass policies: single '/' = explicit no-VAT; context 'no_vat_validation' / import_file skips validation for external API pushes
Webhook trust policy: signed hash_sign token (7-day expiry) verified by verify_hash_signed before accepting IAP status pushes
stakeholders: Tax authority (EU VIES registry; statutory VAT correctness)
Customer & Vendor (res.partner whose VAT is validated)
metrics: vies_valid (boolean Intra-Community validity flag, tracked on chatter)

classification.rationale: base_vat is cross-cutting compliance/tax-validation infrastructure, not a primary value-creating activity — it owns no business entity and only extends res.partner/res.company/res.country to guarantee the correctness of a single master-data attribute (the Tax ID). Stabell & Fjeldstad: 'support' (firm-infrastructure, like accounting/legal). It depends only on account and feeds tax determination & legal invoicing, so APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources (it underpins 9.x tax/AR/AP correctness by validating the VAT used on invoices and fiscal positions). 11.0 Manage Enterprise Risk/Compliance was considered — the EU-VIES check is genuinely a regulatory-compliance control — but rejected as primary because the code lives in the Accounting/Accounting category, depends on account, and exists to keep financial documents (invoices, fiscal positions, tax reports) legally valid; the compliance angle is a facet of the financial-resource management it supports, so 9.0 is the better single fit.

standard_capabilities: Per-country VAT/TIN format and checksum validation (~30 bespoke algorithms + python-stdnum for the rest)
EU intra-community VIES verification via Odoo IAP (sync check + cron poll + signed webhook for pending)
Graceful bypass for explicit no-VAT ('/') and external API pushes (no_vat_validation / import)
typical_fits: Standard EU + global partner VAT validation out of the box
Enabling automatic VIES checks via the Accounting settings toggle
Blocking/normalizing bad Tax IDs at data entry across all res.partner forms
common_gaps: New/changed national VAT rules before python-stdnum catches up (module already patches TW/VN/UY/ID — fresh ones need a localization or core patch)
Non-EU government tax-registry online verification (only EU VIES is wired, via IAP)
Air-gapped/no-IAP deployments cannot perform the online VIES step (format/checksum still works offline)
Bulk re-validation / VIES history reporting beyond the single vies_valid boolean
